description: High-quality financial data and insights on thousands of public companies, designed for AI-native investor workflows. Pull detailed company information, fundamental time series, and market data across a worldwide coverage, backed by a machine-accessible database of millions of company reports, presentations, and transcripts. Trusted many of the world's largest hedge funds and investors.

defaultPrompt: What was Apple's revenue growth by product line in the last 12 quarters?
